title: Monotonicity in the noise parameter
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $0\le\rho\le\sigma\le1$, and let $p\ge1$. For every real-valued function $f$ on $\{−1,1\}^n$, the uniform $L^p$ norm of its noise-operator image at parameter $\rho$ is at most that of its image at parameter $\sigma$.
